application.releaseStatus: Unreleased development; separate draft PR stacked on A03. Historical releases unchanged.

scope: Two independent synthetic walkthroughs with manual settings; activity.json is a handout authoring configuration, not an application import/scenario format.
modelChecks: Default neutral reference remains at 0.5; at generation 20 Trial 1 has 25 A copies, and at generation 40 the four trials have 0, 37, 21 and 7 of 40 copies. Trial 1 first loses A at generation 36.
Default selection reference after one generation is 23/44. At generation 40 the trials have 192, 183, 200 and 200 of 200 A copies; reference frequency is approximately 0.97180908297.
Exact integer counts, complete generations, replay/prefix-stable seeded streams, absorbing loss/fixation and explicit 2N sampling/work bounds are verified.

limits: Synthetic closed constant-size one-locus diploid allele-count model, not individual genotypes/survival or empirical estimates.
